title: Lithic contour lines
description: A decorative layer of thin concentric rings (or ovals) in the surrounding text colour, softly faded at the edges: the hairline contour texture behind Lithic's tinted and dark panels.
notes: CSS only (a repeating radial gradient in currentColor); set the colour and strength with a text class, e.g. text-chart-2/40
absolutely positioned: put it inside a relative, clipped panel
